artifacts.summary: Research for PSS-based reclaimable memory accounting, CPU-delta idle tracking, and notify-before-kill prompt path, covering all three absorbed sub-tasks (dependency-ordered phases, existing seams/fixtures to reuse, structural main() risk for --lean-tree mode).

memory_candidates.content: claude-refresh.sh (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/) uses a PROC_ROOT="${PROC_ROOT:-/proc}" overridable seam so get_vmswap_kb() reads /proc/PID/status through it for test fixtures instead of real /proc. Any new /proc-reading helper (e.g. one parsing smaps_rollup for Pss_Anon/SwapPss/Pss_File) should read through the SAME seam rather than inventing a second one, so one fixture convention covers all /proc-reading functions in the file.

/proc/PID/stat field parsing gotcha: the 2nd field (comm) is parenthesized and can itself contain spaces or parentheses (processes can rename themselves via prctl(PR_SET_NAME)). Naive whitespace-splitting (e.g. awk '{print $22}' for starttime) silently misparses such rows. Safe parse: find the LAST ')' in the line, then split the remainder by whitespace and count fields from there. man proc documents this explicitly for /proc/pid/stat.

lake-build-guard.sh (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/) establishes a reusable systemd-run availability-probe + audible-degrade pattern: 'command -v systemd-run >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1' followed by a cheap no-op 'systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect -- true' liveness probe, with the file's header naming the governing principle "degrade audibly, never silently" for optional dependencies (flock, systemd-run, PSI). Reuse this exact two-step shape for any new systemd-run/notify-send/DBus-session-bus dependency check rather than a bare command -v alone.
